state.paragraph: During the period from the middle of August through the end of October, the Company developed the Profit Improvement Plan and prepared for a sale process. During this period, J.P. Morgan was contacted by 27 potential participants in a sale process, including three strategic parties (not counting Industry Participant) and 24 financial participants (including potential lead buyers as well as large suppliers of equity capital to lead buyers).

ledger_rows.Note: Press release announced exploration of strategic alternatives including a possible sale; uncontacted parties could approach J.P. Morgan.
Not invited: told 08/22 and 08/27 the board would not invite it; may still submit a proposal; no contact since 08/27.
Contacts: 27 parties (3 strategic not counting Industry Participant; 24 financial) approached J.P. Morgan mid-August–end October; ~15 expressed interest by the 10/03 board update.
Round 1 opened by the first-week-of-October confidentiality wave; the 10/30 indication due date was set later.
All 15 received October due diligence, management presentations and detailed financial and business-plan information.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
